Fresh Molds

Design Concept: The Paperplane Reimagined
A piece of paper, folded into the horizon of your imagination.
Three years after the debut of the PAPER series, we return to the 65% form factor. This time, we revisited the paperplane's visual language—asking ourselves: how do we preserve the signature lightness and floating sensation in a more compact body.
Our answer: not to replicate, but to reconstruct.
Moving away from the large backplate and curved waistline of its predecessor, we deconstructed the imagery of a paperplane. We reimagined it into every detail: the folded lines on the sides, the triangular facets on the bottom, and the ambient lighting hidden within the shadows. The result is a 65% that still carries the soul of PAPER.
Featuring:
Extended Side Lines
Precise cuts along the bottom housing echo the signature floating aesthetic of the PAPER series.
Triangular Ambient Light Inserts
Embedded within the bottom case's triangular facets, these lights cast a soft glow onto your desk, creating harmony between the keyboard and the surface.
V-Shaped Tail Lights
Narrow V-shaped light strips race along the angled bottom edges, like afterburners, injecting a sense of motion.
Front Details · Multiple Elements, One Cohesive Design
Across the front face of the PAPER 65, above the main key cluster, several individual components come together:
Strip Indicator Light - Housed in a long, oval, recessed frame, it delivers a sleek, eye-catching glow when lit.
Mirror-Polished Stainless Steel Inlay with Lighting
Acrylic combined with mirror-polished stainless steel for a reflective, high-end texture
Three Small Indicator Lights
Subtly placed to enrich the visual layers.
1U LCD Screen
128×128 resolution, capable of displaying keypress values, GIFs, and connection status.
Anodized Aluminum Trim Bar - Dark anodized finish that visually narrows the top bezel for a more streamlined look.
Paperplane Badge · Icon and Indicator in One
On the front bevel, the paperplane badge continues the design language of the PAPER 80.
Material: Light-diffusing acrylic + resin fill
Function: RGB lighting effects, integrated with Caps Lock indicator
Thoughtful detail: A small window on the top case lets you check Caps Lock status without flipping the board.
The 1U Screen · More Than Meets the Eye
Structure · Dual-Mount Compatibility
The PAPER 65 is designed to support both Bottom Mount and Gasket Mount configurations — giving you the freedom to choose your preferred typing feel.
At the heart of this flexibility is our newly developed bushing-style Bottom Mount system. Featuring precision-engineered acrylic bushings, it works like the hard rubber chassis reinforcements in performance cars: preserving structural rigidity while effectively isolating micro-vibrations from the plate during typing.
The result? Cleaner, purer acoustics — a noticeable step up from traditional top-mount designs.

Although the “endgame” board may be a myth, this one might come close. Meet the Theseus75: a balanced 75% split mechanical keyboard kit designed by @haverworks . With magnetic interlocking, a LEMO-compatible interconnect, and a cushioned typing feel not often found in splits, the Theseus sports a unique combination of features that set this board apart from the rest. Meletrix is back with another addition to their extremely popular Zoom line, and this time in the TKL form factor! This beautiful board offers either a glass or PVD stainless steel back-plate and accents, and ambient side glow.
Zoom TKL EE At a Glance:
Gasket-mount:
The Zoom TKL uses a gasket isolation mount structure for a soft, bouncy, and pleasant typing experience that won't fatigue your fingers during extended use. Gasket mount keyboards also sound better and distribute pressure more evenly throughout the board compared to the typical off-the-rack tray mount keyboards.
Hot-swappable:
The Zoom TKL PCB features Kailh Hot Swap sockets which allows you to easily swap your switches, no soldering required! Changing switches is a breeze, you can go from linears to tactiles in a matter of minutes, all on the same keyboard!
Multi-layout:
Unlike traditional keyboards, you're not stuck with just one layout on the Zoom TKL! Change things up every now and then with split spacebar, split backspace, split left shift and split right shift!
Bluetooth PCB:
Leave the wires behind and use your Zoom TKL with your PC / Mac / tablet / phone with ease. The PCB has a polling rate of 1000hz in wired mode. The included battery can go many weeks between charges. Customize any key in the VIA app for Windows, Mac or Linux.
Ambient Lighting:
The Zoom TKL has added ambient lighting for the first time. We added ambient lighting on both sides of the keyboard with a variety of lighting effects to choose from.
Ergonomic Typing Angle:
The Zoom TKL keyboard is designed with a small slope on the front bezel to reduce the height and ensure your hands can rest on it more comfortably. Additionally, between the F row and the number row, we appropriately increased some width instead of the normal 0.25U gap to prevent accidental touch.
Gasket Sleeves:
The gasket sleeves are made of supercritical foam. It can stabilize the plate while still giving appropriate space for flex. It's the perfect balance.
Included Foam:
Many hours of research has gone into the foam selection to optimize acoustics. The PCB and bottom case foams are composed of lighter PORON material, with denser foam pores. This allows the acoustics to be more concentrated and deeper in pitch than typical dampening materials.
Included Extras:
The Zoom TKL comes with almost everything you need to put together your first keyboard, including an USB-C cable, premium WS stabilizers, and carrying case. All you need are switches and keycaps of your choice to build the ultimate keyboard that's uniquely yours.

Modular Top Right 2u Blocker:

The Zoom75 is highly customizable, featuring 15 standard colors, and four special colorways (anodized black, anodized orange, anodized lavender, and E-white) which also include an engraved telescope design adjacent to the arrow keys!
Customizable Knobs:
Fully customize how you interact with your computer. Knobs allow you to adjust volume, change brush size, and scroll with ease. The Zoom75 provides numerous knob options. The knobs are also interchangeable with the Zoom65 series!
Customizable Badges:
Looking for something more subtle? The Zoom75 offers 11 different badge styles for you to choose from.
Tri-mode PCB:
Use your Zoom75 with your PC, laptop, tablet or even your phone - all without any wires t hanks to Bluetooth 5.0 and 2.4GHz support . You can also use the keyboard in wired mode if that's what you prefer!
Gasket-mount:
The Zoom75 uses a gasket isolation mount structure for a soft, bouncy, and pleasant typing experience that won't fatigue your fingers during extended use. Gasket mount keyboards also sound better and distribute pressure more evenly throughout the board compared to the typical off-the-rack tray mount keyboards.
Gasket Sleeves:
The Zoom75 features gasket sleeves made of unique supercritical foam which is able to both stabilize the plate as well as provide adequate spacing for flex. This results in a typing experience that's well-balanced and neither too stiff or soft.
Various Plate Materials:
The Zoom75 is highly customizable featuring numerous plate options including brass, aluminum, and FR4. Fully customize your typing experience with the Zoom75 EE. Please note, additional plates are sold separately.
Hot-swappable:
The Zoom75 PCB features hot-swap sockets which allows you to easily swap your switches, no soldering required! Changing switches is a breeze, you can go from linears to tactiles in a matter of minutes, all on the same keyboard!
Multi-layout:
Unlike traditional keyboards, you're not stuck with just one layout on the Zoom75! Change things up every now and then with split backspace, left shift, and spacebar! You can also switch between normal and stepped caps lock or ANSI and ISO enter.

Included Foam:
